messages.text: The older terraces here are draughty — a retrofit programme would cut our heating bills and we'd trust the people who run it.
The flats above the station leak heat every winter. Please start a retrofit here.
Our 1970s blocks have the biggest heating bills in town. A retrofit would mean the world to us.
Every roof on our street faces south. Rooftop solar feels like the obvious next step.
We have lawns that only get mowed. Turn one into a community garden and we'll help dig.
The new homes have big clean roofs. A solar scheme would make the estate proud.
The school would love a garden the children can tend — we'll share what we learn.
Between the old apple trees there is perfect soil. A shared garden belongs here.
Our old houses are cold in the wind. Please bring the retrofit programme to Clay Hill.
There's a neglected plot by the weir. A community garden would bring the riverside to life.
Our homes flood and leak heat. Insulation would make Weir Bend easier to live in.
The old mill roof is huge and flat. Solar panels up there would power half the yard.
These car parks could be shaded by solar canopies. It would make shopping under them pleasant.
We grow more than we eat. A community garden would let neighbours share our surplus properly.
We are the keenest gardeners in town. Fund a community garden here and watch it thrive.
The reserve would welcome a small community garden at its edge — berries for walkers, wildlife for all.
